title: Hippocrates Favorite Mattress Goes Mainstream!
excerpt: Here at Hippocrates we’re always introducing new products that we ensure are sustainable, biodegradable, low voc, eco-friendly.
content:
Here at Hippocrates we’re always introducing new products that we ensure are sustainable, biodegradable, low voc, eco-friendly. These are all terms that we’re very used to here at Hippocrates Wellness, but may be considered complex to the normal household.

Lately though, we have seen a shift in the way people are thinking and finding that these terms are now becoming household words. On a quest for better health and well-being, everyone is looking to make the healthier choice, and some companies are playing a big role in driving awareness on the impact of these choices. One such company we’re proud to feature here on the Hippocrates campus: Essentia Natural Memory Foam Mattresses.

Essentia has been at the forefront of this movement by always keeping the user’s complete wellness in mind. By marrying natural and organic ingredients with patented technology and science Essentia offers the total wellness experience that we’re all looking for. That is why we chose Essentia to be our preferred mattress on campus, as our commitment to recovery means that only the most advanced sleep solution would do.

People today have incredible access to information, which is why Essentia stood out by being the most transparent mattress company around. And when you look at the list of ingredients it’s easy to understand why people are making the switch to a clean mattress. Our skin is our largest organ, so while you may be able to pick up a mattress in a box for $800 what is the true cost of the damage it may do to your body in the long run? Traditional flame retardants, cheap materials and toxic fumes all things that can make you sick. So, while the Essentia mattress is an investment, it is an investment in your long-term health and one you won’t regret.

That is why we’re so happy when a brand like Essentia can have its moment in the spotlight. Yes, healthy mattresses are going mainstream! Today we got to see Essentia featured on The Ellen DeGeneres Show as one of the top Earth Day product picks. To celebrate Essentia is offering 20% off their mattress through to April 30, 2017 simply use the promo code: HHIED
